evidence.reason: `runRclone` passes no `env` option, so the child inherits `RCLONE_*` settings. Rclone maps environment variables to its flags, including selection filters such as `RCLONE_MAX_SIZE`; those filters apply to both the copy and the verification operation. A payload skipped by the inherited size filter is therefore absent from both sides of the check, allowing the wrapper to report that the bundle was archived even though the payload was not transferred. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the intended archive operation, not merely a request to enlarge scope. No supplied fixing commit addresses it.
